description: This PHP file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling the listing and editing views for the 'Releases' module. It includes access control, rendering of list views with buttons, and an edit form for release records.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in SuiteCRM, managing headers, buttons, and data display.
